notes.subject: בנה בניתי
notes.rationale: Infinitive-absolute doubling 'building I built' for emphasis; rendered 'so da-ka-da' to keep the echo.

notes.subject: זבל
notes.rationale: Rare word 'exalted residence' (only here and Isa 63:15 in this sense); kept as plain 'sigiyɔrɔ'.

notes.subject: ⟨i⟩
notes.rationale: Pronoun added: Hebrew לך carries 'for you' but Bambara needs the free pronoun.

notes.subject: עולמים
notes.rationale: Plural 'עוֹלָמִים' (ages) rendered as single adverbial 'jaman kɔrɔ kɔrɔ'; plural shape lost.

translation: So da-ka-da: ne ye ⟨i⟩ ye so dɔ da — sigiyɔrɔ sumanen, i ka sigilen-yɔrɔ, jaman kɔrɔ kɔrɔ.
